title: FMGE Mini Test Series · FMGE Mini Test Series Year 2024 · Fmge Mini Test 8

questions.stem: A new screening test for detecting cervical cancer is being studied in a group of 100 women. 60 women tested negative and 40 tested positive. Among the women who were tested positive by the new test 30 were actually positive and among the women who tested negative, 10 were having the disease. What is the positive predictive value of the test?
